purpose: The classic Hermes CLI reports its turn state to Rex with OSC 7501 (Rex's Program Status Protocol): working while a turn runs, blocked with kind permission/question/auth while a prompt waits, then done or error. Rex shows this as tab activity and alerts, as it does for Claude Code. Emitted only when TERM_PROGRAM=rex.
source: The same bytes as dotfiles hermes/runtime-patches/rex-program-status.patch (its behaviour tests: dotfiles hermes/test_hermes_rex_program_status.py). Nix needs its own copy to pin it in the store; change both together.
apply: In the Hermes source root: `git apply --check <patch>`, `git apply <patch>`, then require each files[].patched_sha256 (at base_commit). Reverse with `git apply -R <patch>`. Restart Hermes CLI sessions to load it; the gateway does not use it. The updater admits the patch only as the exact content of its file applied to HEAD.
